input.summary: Complete A-B to light double bonus. Shoot one side's spinner until its bonus reaches 50,000, collect 100,000 at that side saucer, and refill it.

steps.text: Plunge the top saucer for 5,000 and one bonus advance.
Nudge the saucer exit so the bumpers can knock down A and B. A-B lights double bonus.
Choose the spinner with the safer return. Repeat it to build that side's bonus.
At 50,000 bonus, the spinner rises from 100 to 1,000 per spin.
After double bonus is lit, collect the full side bonus at its saucer for 100,000.
Return to that spinner. Refill the side and repeat the doubled collect.

quickInfo.name: Double bonus
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-B to double side-saucer and end-of-ball bonus collects; it does not multiply general playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: Side bonus
quickInfo.summary: Each spinner builds its own side toward 50,000, where that spinner rises from 100 to 1,000 per spin.

quickInfo.name: Saucer collect
quickInfo.summary: A full 50,000 side scores 100,000 at its saucer after double bonus is lit, then can be refilled.

quickInfo.name: Drain collect
quickInfo.summary: At the drain, only the side indicated by the lit red arrow is awarded.

fallback.title: Spinner and end-of-ball collect
fallback.when: Use this plan when a side-saucer eject does not return safely.

steps.text: Leave the full doubled bonus uncollected.
Keep shooting the 1,000-per-spin side.
Before the drain, note which side arrow is lit. That side is collected at end of ball.
modeNotes: Verify that double bonus affects bonus collects only and that the drain awards the side shown by the lit arrow.

alternatives.title: Extra-ball route
alternatives.when: Use this only when extra balls are enabled and count in the event.

steps.text: Complete A-B twice to light an inlane extra ball.
Complete A-B a third time to award it directly.
Complete A-B to light double bonus.
Build one side to 50,000 through its spinner.
Collect 100,000 at that side saucer.
Refill the same side and collect it again.

playfieldReferences.label: Top saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Skill-shot saucer worth 5,000 and one bonus advance.

playfieldReferences.label: A-B drops
playfieldReferences.description: Upper drops whose completion lights double bonus and later Extra Ball awards.

playfieldReferences.label: Side spinners
playfieldReferences.description: Two side spinners that build their respective bonus and increase at 50,000.

playfieldReferences.label: Side bonus saucers
playfieldReferences.description: Two side saucers used to collect the built bonus for that side.

playfieldReferences.label: End-of-ball side arrow
playfieldReferences.description: Lit arrow identifying which side bonus is collected when the ball drains.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Nudge the top-saucer exit toward the bumpers. Bumper hits can knock down A and B for double bonus.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: Dead bounce a clean feed across the open inlane gap instead of attempting an imperfect Live catch.

cautions.issue: A live catch can roll through the gap above an inlane and drain.
cautions.response: Use dead-bounce passes. Do not use an imperfect live catch, alley pass, or unnecessary post pass.

cautions.issue: A side-saucer kickout can return down the middle or reach only the end of the same-side flipper.
cautions.response: Test each kickout. Use the end-of-ball fallback when a controlled return is not possible.

cautions.issue: A weak spinner shot can fall onto a sling and return down the middle.
cautions.response: Use only the spinner that reaches the top reliably.

cautions.issue: The open gap above each inlane can drain a fast ball after a catch attempt.
cautions.response: Let a safe feed dead bounce instead of stopping it high on the flipper.

cautions.issue: A fast spinner or bonus countdown can make a score reel skip a 100,000 step.
cautions.response: Stop and call the tournament director if the displayed score does not advance correctly.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm ball count and whether Extra Ball, Special, and replay awards remain active, are disabled, or receive point substitutes.
Test both spinners, both side-saucer kickouts, the top saucer, A-B drops, red-arrow indication, score reels, and tilt sensitivity.
Verify that double bonus affects bonus collects only and that the drain awards the side shown by the lit arrow.
input.simpleOverview: In Grand Prix, complete A-B to light Double Bonus, then choose the side spinner with the safer return and repeat it until that side's bonus reaches 50,000. Shoot the matching saucer to collect 100,000, refill the same side through its spinner, and collect it again.
input.overview: In Grand Prix, A-B lights Double Bonus, each side spinner builds its own bonus to 50,000, and the matching saucer collects that side. Complete A-B, repeat the safer spinner until its value reaches 50,000 and the spinner rises to 1,000 per spin, then shoot that side's saucer for 100,000. Refill the same side and repeat the collect.
